detected_by: WARNING: mandate_headline sanity check failed printed by pf1e_dashboard_producer.py, and a later site-dashboard-check FAIL despite the just-published copy being self-consistent
impact: one real publish run had to be repeated with CODEX_REPO_ROOT set explicitly before the dashboard's two work-inventory sources agreed on the total; the site-dashboard-check verify.sh stage still failed afterward (STALE), most likely from the shared cache being rewritten again by a concurrent agent between the real publish and the --check re-run
resolution: exported CODEX_REPO_ROOT to this worktree's absolute path for every publish-site-dashboard.sh invocation; did not attempt to fix the shared-cache race or the harness's own repo-root default, both out of this lane's file scope
summary: publish-site-dashboard.sh internally shells to a fresh v06_work_inventory --summary subprocess whose repo cwd defaults to DEFAULT_REPO_ROOT (~/workspace/repos/codex, the shared checkout) unless CODEX_REPO_ROOT is exported; from a worktree this silently summarizes the WRONG tree's corpus, producing a mandate_headline sanity-check denominator mismatch (stale total vs this worktree's fresh ladder sum) even though the committed full_document was correct. A second contributor: the subprocess's own result cache lives at the cross-agent-shared ~/swarm-observer/work-inventory-summary.json, so a concurrent lane's run can also overwrite it mid-cycle
